title: Over it.
content:
I get so frustrated every time I use this app. The picture resizing is ridiculous. I should be able to just type in the size I want rather than having to manually resize it myself. Also not necessarily the app but the ink subscription is also ridiculous. I get it says that it “charges per page” but I don’t care you’re ripping people off. It has charged me over $30 a month for the past three months and I have had the same ink cartridges since I put the insta ink ones in. I regret buying an Hp printer and it won’t be happening again and I would never recommend someone else buy one. I may try to sell or honestly trash this one and buy from a different company. I’m sure no one at the company will care about my opinion because they are going to unfortunately continue to make money anyways but if I can at least deter one person from dealing with the frustration I have dealt with, me writing this and possibly many more will be worth it.
